generationApi.accepted: Adult fresh generation; public WorldPawns handoff of owned unspawned candidates only.
generationApi.rejected: Using private DiscardGeneratedPawn outside its generation stack; generating from arbitrary faction names without real world eligibility.

saveAudit.accepted: Inventory of 40 saved fields in 5 classes and 12 proposed manual checks.
corrections: Despawn alone does not imply a reference becomes null. Loaded-object registration and retention matter.
Missing-container guards do not prove all malformed saves are safe.
Loose deep-saved goods and quality were subsequently exercised in a real isolated save/reload.

travelDutyAudit.accepted: Native TravelOrLeave duty and periodic TravelArrived evaluation; approach still needs physical reachability.
travelDutyAudit.limits: Metadata does not prove a custom think-tree override is required. Actual approach and departure were tested separately.

scheduleCases.nativeScope: 24 Delay projections plus selected real scheduler transitions; not all 24 model transitions executed in game.

acceptedWithEdits: Purchased batch can be a partial stack.
Animals and equal distribution among all members are not required.
Actual dropped silver drives income; pending escrow is not yet reported as received.
Avoid unverified exact vanilla inventory tab labels and absolute route isolation promises.

corrections: ToolUser is a race intelligence/property check, not proof of the generated pawn's manipulation capacity.
No pack animals is supported by a human fallback; it is not itself a reason for generation failure.
The report paraphrases TryVisit using a different collection/null predicate; actual source uses AllFactionsListForReading.
The require_animals mutation rejects every case rather than modelling a real carrier flag; it only checks that some no-animal fixtures must remain eligible.
Python float does not prove every Single rounding boundary. No guarantee for all future modded factions.

documentationConsistency.limits: No contradiction found in the specified files and rules; this is not proof of all documentation consistency or game correctness. The report overstates its global conclusion.
